# Deploy static site to AWS

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Sync a build directory to S3 with correct cache headers and invalidate CloudFront

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/deploy-aws-static@v1
  with:
    source: # Local directory to publish.
    bucket: # Target S3 bucket name.
```

## How it works

Publish a static site to S3 and invalidate CloudFront.

The part people get wrong is cache headers, so this action makes the correct behaviour the
default. Static site generators emit two kinds of file:

  • Fingerprinted assets (`app.4f3a2b.js`) — safe to cache forever, and you *want* them
    cached forever, because the filename changes when the content does.
  • Entry points (`index.html`, `sw.js`, manifests) — must never be cached at the edge or
    visitors keep loading an old app shell that references deleted asset filenames.

So the upload happens in two passes: long-lived immutable assets first, then no-cache
entry points, then the delete pass. Uploading in that order means a visitor mid-deploy can
never fetch a new HTML file that points at assets which haven't landed yet.

Authenticate with `aws-auth` first.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | **yes** | — | Local directory to publish. |
| `bucket` | **yes** | — | Target S3 bucket name. |
| `prefix` | no | `""` | Key prefix within the bucket, e.g. `previews/pr-42`. Empty means the root. |
| `distribution-id` | no | `""` | CloudFront distribution to invalidate. Empty skips invalidation. |
| `invalidation-paths` | no | `/*` | Space-separated paths to invalidate. |
| `immutable-globs` | no | `*.js *.css *.woff2 *.woff *.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.gif *.svg *.webp *.avif *.ico *.mp4` | Space-separated globs treated as fingerprinted and cached for a year. Matched against the key path. |
| `no-cache-globs` | no | `*.html *.json *.xml *.txt sw.js` | Space-separated globs served with `no-cache`, always revalidated. |
| `immutable-cache-control` | no | `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` | Cache-Control header for immutable assets. |
| `no-cache-cache-control` | no | `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate` | Cache-Control header for entry points. |
| `delete` | no | `true` | true to remove objects in the bucket that no longer exist in `source`. |
| `dry-run` | no | `false` | true to show what would change without writing anything. |
| `extra-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to every `aws s3 sync` call. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `bucket-url` | s3:// URI that was published to. |
| `invalidation-id` | The CloudFront invalidation ID, when one was created. |
